<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><style>body{margin:0;background:#000}canvas{display:block}</style></head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="1280" height="720"></canvas>
<script src="shared.js"></script>
<script src="characters.js"></script>
<script src="maps.js"></script>
<script>
  const ctx = document.getElementById('c').getContext('2d');
  const key = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('map') || 'skylands';
  const cam = { x: 0, y: -30 };
  MAPRENDER.drawBackground(ctx, key, 1280, 720, cam, 3.2);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(640, 360);
  const s = 720 / 900 * 0.9;
  ctx.scale(s, s);
  ctx.translate(-cam.x, -cam.y);
  MAPRENDER.drawPlatforms(ctx, key, 3.2);
  const fighters = [
    ['blaze', 'smash', 0.26, 1, -340, 210],
    ['titan', 'jab', 0.16, -1, -120, 210],
    ['volt', 'run', 0.7, 1, 180, 210],
    ['shade', 'smash', 0.23, -1, 400, 210]
  ];
  for (const [c, anim, t, face, x, y] of fighters) {
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y);
    FIGHTERS.drawFighter(ctx, c, anim, t, face, {});
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.restore();
</script>
</body>
</html>
